name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close
title: Leaf view simulated without a trapdoor for B (generic finite ring, leftover hash)
statement: Over a finite commutative ring K: B uniform, R binary (m x mW), (W, T) <- S(B) for any setup kernel S, and a public check good(T). Real view (attribute 0, phi(0) = 0): A = B R and, if good(T), the leaf key is one try of box rejection for [B | A_phi - G] with the simulation trapdoor evalSim(phi, A T_W[j], 0, R T_W[j]); otherwise bottom. Simulated view (attribute w, phi(w) = 0): A = sum_i w_i W_i + B R and the trapdoor evalSim(phi, ..., w, R T_W[j] - sum_i w_i T_B[i,j]). Assuming the succinct-LWE block identity B T_B[i,j] + W_i T_W[j] = delta_ij G and box coverage on good outputs of S, the two views (B, (W, T), A, key) are within 2 * mW * sqrt(|K|^n / 2^m) / 2 (CloseTo). The real scheme needs no trapdoor for B.
